comparison.objective: Remove or move the existing dicer grid, fit the replacement grid under its pusher, and lower the pusher.
comparison.physical_skill: Grid extraction, planar insertion/alignment, and mechanism closure; no impact fracture or loose-fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Replacement grid is fitted and pusher lowered; the available record gives run limit and demo score but no fit tolerances or damage rubric.
comparison.reason: It tests component swapping and insertion under a mechanism, meaningfully different from breaking four tangs and recovering each fragment.
